left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Women aged 18 or older undergoing medical  [OR] or surgical abortion at Planned Parenthood of Illinois (PPIL) will be eligible for inclusion

Inclusion criteria include having an intrauterine pregnancy, having a smart phone to be able to follow-up by text message 2-4 weeks after the clinic appointment, having no contraindications to an outpatient medication  [OR] or surgical abortion that same day, and not meeting any exclusion criteria

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Exclusion criteria will include non-English speaking, no working telephone, and less than 5th grade education level
